concerns.text: Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it **produces** the raw archive needed by T002 and T003. Parallel execution would break the Data Availability Gate, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.
Task T002 is also marked `[P]` yet it **consumes** the file created by T001. It cannot safely run in parallel with its producer.
Task T003 is marked `[P]` but relies on both the download (T001) and the gate check (T002). The `[P]` tag incorrectly suggests it can run concurrently with its producers.
Task T009 is tagged `[P]` yet it validates the output of the baseline pipeline (T008). It must run after T008, so the parallel‑safe annotation is inaccurate.
